title: External Research Watchlist → EFC Graph Target Mapping + AI Synthesis (DRAFT)
purpose: Human-curated mapping from watchlist canonical keys to EFCValidation test_ids, gap_ids, or competing-framework relations, extended with AI-drafted synthesis at two levels: per-paper doc_synthesis and per-cluster cluster_commentary. Consumed by the external_watchlist_to_graph parser AND by external_research_ledger_publisher for rendering the public EFC_External_Research_Ledger.html. All ledger-facing prose is in English.
language_policy: All ledger-facing text fields (doc_synthesis.draft, cluster_commentary.draft, rendered headers) MUST be in English. Internal reasoning/notes fields may be bilingual. Renderer rejects ledger-facing content that is not English.
test_id_source: Neo4j EFCValidation nodes, 2026-04-18 snapshot (288 entries, 233 with non-null test_id)

synthesis_method.source: AI-drafted by claude-opus-4-7 from watchlist metadata fields only — title, efc_relevance, ledger_action, source_type. NOT based on full-text reading of referenced papers or abstracts.
synthesis_method.implication: Synthesis quality is bounded by the information Morten himself encoded in the watchlist. Where watchlist metadata is thin (e.g. pure cross-checks), drafts may be less informative.
synthesis_method.upgrade_path: For deeper synthesis of individual papers, either (a) have Claude fetch the abstract/full text at render time, or (b) write manual synthesis. Flag papers needing upgrade with 'requires_deeper_synthesis: true' at the entry level.
synthesis_method.verification_gate: Every draft field has verified_by_morten flag. Renderer refuses to publish unverified drafts — displays 'Synthesis pending review' placeholder instead.

parser_safety_contract.pre_run_check: Parser MUST refuse execution while last_verified_by_morten is null.
parser_safety_contract.graph_status_rule: If graph_status = 'not_found', parser MUST log and SKIP — never create implicit Gap/Test nodes.
parser_safety_contract.authority_rule: This file is advisory. It never overrides explicit graph facts.
parser_safety_contract.commentary_rendering_rule: external_research_ledger_publisher MUST check verified_by_morten per doc_synthesis AND per cluster_commentary independently. Unverified drafts render as 'Synthesis pending review'. Never publish AI text without Morten's explicit approval.
parser_safety_contract.language_rule: Renderer MUST verify ledger-facing strings are English. Non-English content blocks rendering with an error.

confidence_scale.high: ledger_action or efc_relevance explicitly names a graph-known identifier
confidence_scale.medium: thematically clear; single plausible candidate and no equally strong alternative
confidence_scale.low: multiple plausible candidates OR indirect linkage — do not auto-confirm

kind_semantics.test: Publication informs or provides data for this EFCValidation. Proposed edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS]->(EFCValidation)
kind_semantics.gap: Publication bears on resolution of this knowledge gap. Edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS_GAP]->(Gap) or BLOCKS_RESOLUTION_OF.
kind_semantics.framework: Publication represents a competing theoretical framework. Parser multi-labels as (:Publication:Framework) and creates (Publication)-[:COMPETES_WITH]->(Theory {canonical: 'EFC'}).

commentary_linguistic_policy.principle: Conservative wording at both doc and cluster level. Consistency is not confirmation. Use 'informs', 'tightens', 'constrains', 'challenges', 'suggests parallel direction', 'remains consistent with'. NEVER use 'supports', 'confirms', 'validates', 'proves' unless explicitly backed by a sealed blind test result in the graph.
commentary_linguistic_policy.length: doc_synthesis: 2-3 sentences. cluster_commentary: 2-4 sentences. Longer goes in working notes, not the public ledger.
red_flags_to_avoid: Asserting directionality (X supports Y) when mechanism is shared with competing frameworks

graph_status_legend.confirmed: Target node verified present in Neo4j at generation time
graph_status_legend.not_found: Target not found; parser logs warning and skips edge
graph_status_legend.not_applicable: Framework kind — implicit EFC Theory node

gap_materialization_note.interpretation: The three canonical gap_ids do not exist in the graph under any label. Create them via docs/validation-ledger/data/ flow, NOT as a side-effect of this parser.

synthesis_clusters.description: Editorial groupings of watchlist items by theme. Each cluster has an AI-drafted cluster_commentary (English, 2-4 sentences) used as section lead in the External Research Ledger.

clusters.name: DESI DR2 and dynamical dark energy (w₀wₐ)

cluster_commentary.draft: DESI DR2 shows a 3.1σ preference for w₀wₐ over a pure cosmological constant, independently reproduced by the Nature Astronomy reanalysis. The direction is compatible with EFC's L2→L3 regime transition and with α = −0.14 ± 0.21. The same signal is, however, also predicted by holographic dark energy, quintessence, and several other frameworks — the field is moving away from ΛCDM, but it does not select EFC over competitors.

clusters.name: DES Y6 and the S8 tension (2026 series)

cluster_commentary.draft: DES Y6 delivers S8 ≈ 0.79 from both cosmic shear and 3×2pt — 2.4–2.7σ lower than Planck+ACT+SPT (0.836), while KiDS-Legacy sits close to Planck. The 2026 review paper consolidates the picture: the probe split is a real feature, not an artifact. EFC's pre-registered DES Y6 P3 PASS (0.944 ± 0.018) and μ(a)<1 prediction survive the published numbers, but the observed tension admits multiple explanations beyond EFC — including baryonic feedback, intrinsic-alignment systematics, and other μ<1 models.

Joint ACT + SPT + Planck CMB lensing reaches S8 = 0.825 at 1.6% precision (SNR 61). The precision exceeds what EFC's current Boltzmann-based pipeline handles numerically. This elevates the theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver gap to blocking: without a production-ready hi_class integration, EFC cannot meet this precision level head-to-head.

clusters.name: JWST Bullet Cluster — independent mass reconstructions

cluster_commentary.draft: Two independent JWST mass reconstructions of the Bullet Cluster are now available: 146 strong-lensing constraints with dense weak-lensing source density (Cha/Jee/Finner) and 135 multiple images across 27 spectroscopic systems (Rihtaršič/Bradač). EFC's pre-registered δκ shock-front test (figshare 31963668) therefore has the observational data it requires. The bottleneck is EFC's internal pipeline, not the data — delivery responsibility lies with us, not with the field.

clusters.name: Rotation curves — data and competing models

cluster_commentary.draft: BIG-SPARC extends rotation-curve data beyond the 175-galaxy SPARC sample. In parallel, arXiv:2601.00522 presents a new empirical model claiming to outperform both MOND and CDM halos. Both point to the same next step: execute Kill-Test v6 universality on the expanded data, then run head-to-head ΔAIC comparison against the competitor. No EFC analysis has yet run against these new resources.

Euclid DR1 (2100 deg² cosmic shear) lands on 2026-10-21 and is expected to arbitrate the DES Y6 vs KiDS-Legacy S8 disagreement. EFC holds a sealed pre-registered pipeline (figshare 31990053, B0=0.02, M0=0.06). No directional assessment is to be written before DR1 is publicly released — this is a genuine blind test, not a consistency check.

Informational Entropic Gravity (2026 preprint) is the closest ontological relative to EFC published this year — an alternative formulation of gravity as macroscopic informational-entropy equilibrium on holographic boundaries. arXiv:2601.00522 represents an empirical competitor on the rotation-curve front. Both require formal recovery-conditions comparison (WP1) and head-to-head ΔAIC evaluation before any relative assessment. These are positions EFC must be chosen over, not mere consistency checks.
cluster_commentary.note: arXiv:2601.00522 appears in two clusters (rotation_curves_and_competitors + competing_frameworks) — intentional dual membership.

cluster_commentary.draft: A 34-entry taxonomy of canonical competing frameworks, spanning dark-energy parametrizations (ΛCDM, wCDM/CPL, quintessence, EDE, holographic DE, Kaniadakis, quintom, coupled DE/DM, thawing quintessence), modified gravity (MOND, TeVeS, RMOND, f(R), DGP, Weyl-geometric, Machian, massive gravity), scalar-tensor/Horndeski sub-classes (full Horndeski, Galileon, KGB, Brans-Dicke), emergent and entropic gravity (Jacobson, Padmanabhan, Verlinde 2010, Verlinde 2016, mass-to-horizon cosmology), alternative cosmologies (CCC, Timescape, Ekpyrotic, MiHsC), and particle-sector dark matter alternatives (SIDM, fuzzy DM, superfluid DM, PBH). Each is positioned by EFC's recovery-conditions or discriminator structure, never by superiority claims. Ontology-sharing members (Jacobson, Padmanabhan, Verlinde) are explicit ancestors; sign-discriminator members (f(R), Galileon, KGB) sit on the FA2 axis; particle-sector DM is flagged as orthogonal, not competing. The taxonomy provides Symbiose with a stable reference graph for future automated comparisons.
